meta_title: Feel Home Stays | Rooms & flat to rent in Frankfurt Nordend, book direct
meta_desc: Furnished private rooms and a 1-bedroom flat with balcony in Frankfurt Nordend, 1 min from Grüneburgweg U-Bahn. Self check-in, business invoices, book direct.
hero_h1: Your furnished home in Frankfurt Nordend
hero_sub: Two private rooms and a flat with balcony, one minute from Grüneburgweg station. Self check-in, fair prices and invoices for business stays.
spaces_h2: Pick the one that fits your trip
spaces_lead: The two private rooms are in the same shared flat — ideal for a solo trip or a couple. The flat with balcony is the whole place to yourselves.
c1_desc: A compact private room for a short, easy stay — solo or as a couple. Close to public transport and the city centre.
c2_desc: Prime location — 1 minute from Grüneburgweg, 3 minutes from the cafés of Oeder Weg, 10 minutes to the city centre. Free parking after 10 pm and at weekends.
c3_desc: The whole flat, with a balcony and a baby cot on request — made for families. Same prime location, 1 minute from Grüneburgweg.
transit_h2: Well placed, whichever way you're headed
how_lead: No one meets you at the door — access details, house guide and check-in instructions arrive by message once you have booked.
s1_p: Choose your space and dates. You see the full price up front and get an email confirmation with a payment link.
s2_p: Digital entry instructions reach you by message before check-in, from 3:00 pm.
s3_p: Arrive whenever suits your travel. Check-out is by 11:00 am.
footer_p: Three furnished stays in Frankfurt, bookable direct or on Airbnb and Booking.com. Invoices for company stays on request.
